"For the purposes of this rule the following definitions will apply to the described terms; Sec. 3.1 Encounter is defined as a consensual interaction with an individual that does not escalate into a formal stop and/or frisk."

This means that an encounter involves a voluntary interaction between an officer and an individual where there is no intention to detain or search the individual further than what is necessary for the initial interaction. The encounter must be consensual and not escalate into a more formal stop or frisk procedure.
